verdict.rationale: Folk's integrations page documents syncing Gmail conversations and automatically importing conversations and contacts into folk, which covers the core of connecting email and logging it. Outlook, two-way sync, and matching emails to the correct records are not evidenced. Missing for 10: Outlook connection, documented two-way sync behavior, automatic association of emails to the right person/company/deal records, in-depth docs and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records

citations.quote: Automatically import your conversations and contacts into folk
